content.text:
Vance Oduya doesn't look up from the departure ledger when Mira leans into the dock office. He runs one oil-black finger down the column of berths as if she'd asked him about the weather.

<npc>"Courier left two days back,"</npc> he says. <npc>"Unregistered skiff out of berth nine. Paid the departure tax in Ascendancy scrip."</npc> He turns the ledger so she can read it: no name, a berth number, a stamp neither of them recognises.

Out on the docking ring Ren keeps his back to the bulkhead, counting the dockhands who have stopped working to watch the office door — three of them, and one is already walking away.
